ns2:section.sectionText: This section will have one or more proctored online exams which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU, approved proctoring centers, and approved testing facilities that carry no fees. For ProctorU technical specifications and additional information visit: http://citl.illinois.edu/services/for-students/proctoru. It is encouraged that registration happens before Friday, June 9.
